topic: DNA, Genes, and Chromosomes in Trait Transmission
key_concepts: DNA is deoxyribonucleic acid and contains the genetic code
DNA has four nitrogenous bases: adenine, cytosine, guanine, and thymine
Adenine pairs with thymine and cytosine pairs with guanine
DNA is a double helix whose two strands are connected by hydrogen bonds
In eukaryotic cells, DNA is located in the nucleus
Helicase unzips the DNA double helix during replication
DNA polymerase helps synthesize new DNA strands during replication
Genes are segments of DNA that code for proteins and influence traits
Chromosomes are threadlike structures made of DNA and proteins
Human somatic cells have 46 chromosomes arranged in 23 pairs
One set of chromosomes comes from the mother and one from the father
